description: Given an MCP tool name, return its credit cost so you can preview an action before running it. Also accepts a stream type (external_profile, company, topic, person_interests, hiring_signals, ad_watch) to preview the per-page cost create_stream / run_stream_now will charge. Returns { tool_name, cost, balance, sufficient, stream_cost? }. Tools not in the registry are assumed to cost 0. Free.
